deficiencies.description: The rewrite asserts that the slice through a tumour illustrates explanting the tumour ('illustrates this'), creating a link between the slice and explantation that the lecturer did not make.
deficiencies.sourcePassage: Here you're looking at a slice through a tumor and a stain to look at the morphology.
deficiencies.rewritePassage: A slice through a tumour, with a stain to show the morphology, illustrates this [FIGURE].
deficiencies.caseForForbidden: The rewrite links the figure of a stained tumour slice to the preceding statement about explanting tumours by claiming it 'illustrates this', which adds an unsourced conceptual connection not present in the lecture.
deficiencies.caseForAllowed: The phrase 'illustrates this' is simply stylistic boilerplate used to introduce the figure showing the tumour slice and stain.
